daily_check.result: Read saved progress and supplied fresh recruiting observations; show coverage, reply/action queues and archive candidates without mutations.

daily_update.result: Record reviewed daily evidence and exact role updates, freeze human-confirmed archive selections and retain verified host outcomes; no new applications or unsolicited replies.

review_inbox.result: Read full relevant mail, reconcile outcomes, save evidence and checkpoint; show reply queue with email links.

tidy_inbox.result: Archive individually resolved application confirmations and rejections with before/after labels; preserve unanswered requests.

discover.result: Produce a source-bounded or broad deduplicated shortlist with fit, unknowns and canonical records.

apply.result: Complete authorised suitable applications up to a cap; freeze packets, reserve, submit once, save confirmed or unknown outcomes.

schedule.result: Verify latest availability, book chosen time, accept calendar invitation, save evidence and authorised reply.

prepare_interview.result: Refresh the exact vacancy brief with plain company explanation, sourced stories, natural opening and questions.

update_knowledge.result: Attribute supplied knowledge, reuse new answers, link interview notes and keep coaching separate from facts.

reconcile.result: Review stale/conflicting records and unfinished attempts; fix with evidence and rebuild the tracker.
